text:
The two immediate-successor constraints lock Ben–Cara–Dev into three consecutive slots and Hana–Ivo into two, and Ivo before Cara forces the pair to sit entirely before that triple. Finn before Hana by at least three slots forces Hana at slot 5 or later, which leaves only Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9 and Hana–Ivo in 5–6, with Finn in 1.

Slots 2–4 then hold Ann, Elif, and Gus. Elif before Ivo, Ann before Gus, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, and Ann at least three slots from Ivo place them as Elif, Ann, Gus. Every other block placement breaks at least one constraint.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Elif","3":"Ann","4":"Gus","5":"Hana","6":"Ivo","7":"Ben","8":"Cara","9":"Dev"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
